parameters.name: ActionType
parameters.description:
The alert type.

- ALERT: An alert is triggered.

- RESUME: The service has recovered.

parameters.name: EndTimestamp
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. This is a UNIX timestamp.

parameters.name: EntityType
parameters.description:
The alert object.

- GTM\_ADDRESS: Address

- GTM\_ADDRESS\_POOL: Address pool

- GTM\_INSTANCE: Instance

- GTM\_MONITOR\_TEMPLATE: Health check template

parameters.name: Keyword
parameters.description: The keyword for the search. This is usually an address ID, address pool ID, or domain name.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the response.

- zh-CN: Chinese

- en-US: English

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The current page number. The value starts from **1**. The default value is **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query. The maximum value is 100. The default value is 20.

parameters.name: StartTimestamp
parameters.description: The start of the time range to query. This is a UNIX timestamp.
